notes.title: v1.94 Update
notes.notes:
This update brings native OSVR support (win64), enables another music track & adds a virtual reality "thumbstick" option that should improve Oculus Touch compatibility. v1.94 also has more improvements listed below.

To test the native OSVR plugin, use the "Launch OSVR" option.

I fixed a bug that caused the 5th music track to not play -- you should hear it now!

When playing in VR, and you want to use Oculus Touch controllers, try setting the "Thumb Mode" to "Thumbstick" under "Input Config". Vive wands have a Touchpad, which is the default "Thumb Mode".

This update is currently on the [BETA] branch, so you'll need to opt-in via 5089 -> Properties -> Betas.

11/13/2016 Update: Added a 5089-osvr.bat launching script, which will handle passing the "osvr" argument to launch with the native OSVR SDK.

v1.94 Update also addresses the following:
[list]
[*]Fixes story background on "safe" graphics mode
[*]Grappling hook properly disconnects when entering or leaving the hatch
[*]Improved building placement to not overlap over roads
[*]Fixed the non-VR option to not actually start SteamVR
[/list]

notes.title: v1.91 VR Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added a message saying vehicle & grappling hook use is disabled in "room scale" mode, since these would require artificial movement. If you want to use these features in VR, use "Mixed" or "Sitting" movement modes.
[*]Added support for a vrsettings.txt file, which can tweak GUI graphics. Details below.
[*]v1.90: Added an option to disable rain effects, which may have caused some performance problems for some users
[*]v1.91: Fixed messages starting from the top when repositioned using different values via vrsettings.txt
[*]v1.91: Added options to move the detection HUD element via vrsettings.txt
[/list]

If you would like to change some of the GUI positioning & sizing parameters used in virtual reality, I've added support for a vrsettings.txt file. 5089 will look for that file in your home directory's 5089 folder. For example, on Windows, it would be located at "C:\Users\<your username>\5089\vrsettings.txt". This is the default contents & values:

VR_RADAR_X=0.2
VR_RADAR_Y=0.3
VR_HUDPOS_X=0.2
VR_HUDPOS_Y=0.2
VR_DETECTION_POS_X=0.6
VR_DETECTION_POS_Y=0.3
VR_OVERALL_GUI_SCALE=0.333
VR_MESSAGES_OFFSET=0.8
VR_GUI_RESOLUTION_CAP_WIDTH=1280
VR_GUI_RESOLUTION_CAP_HEIGHT=960

Some good values for renderTargetMultiplier of 2.0:

VR_RADAR_X=0.55
VR_RADAR_Y=0.65 
VR_HUDPOS_X=0.55
VR_HUDPOS_Y=0.45 
VR_DETECTION_POS_X=0.6
VR_DETECTION_POS_Y=0.45
VR_OVERALL_GUI_SCALE=0.5
VR_MESSAGES_OFFSET=0.6
VR_GUI_RESOLUTION_CAP_WIDTH=1600
VR_GUI_RESOLUTION_CAP_HEIGHT=1200

If you want to change or apply values, make a vrsettings.txt file, put it in that location, and tweak away. All numbers are percentages, except for the GUI_RESOLUTION_CAP values. Higher X/Y values will push those things more to the right/up. Smaller VR_MESSAGES_OFFSET values will put messages further down the screen. The bigger the GUI scale, the bigger the GUI will be. The RESOLUTION_CAP will increase the GUI "canvas" size.

Feel free to tweak the numbers to get something that works best for you. This should also help people who want to move the GUI around in VR, but don't mess with supersampling.

notes.title: v1.82 Update: VR Controller Improvement
notes.notes: The "oriented action" feature is a common source of confusion when using the Vive wands in VR. This update clears up just what that button will do, depending on how your Vive wand is oriented. The labeled wand will now update what the action will be, as you oriented the wand in different directions in realtime. For example, when pointing the wand up, it will say "Oriented Action (Stealth)", indicating it will toggle stealth mode. This should help improve the intuitiveness of many important functions that use this input method!

notes.title: v1.81 Update (May 29th, 2016)
notes.notes:
This update includes many backend updates & VR updates.
[list]
[*]Increased melee range (for both you & ant bots)
[*]Melee weapons are now automatic (holding standard attack will repeatedly attack, also really helpful for VR)
[*]Extended the range to interact with stations & bots. This should also really help in VR when trying to position yourself close to things
[*]Moved labels closer to the center when viewing the map in VR (easier to see nearby stations etc.)
[*]Removed energy use of teleporting tools in VR (since they are so often integral to general movement)
[*]Smoothed out cursor control when using the Vive wand touchpad
[*]Updated the map viewing system for better use in VR
[*]Updated to the latest jMonkeyEngine, LWJGL & Java builds
[*]Fixed a typo when using Backup stations
[/list]
v1.72 adds:
[list]
[*]VR: Enabled the physics box around the player in Room Scale mode, so bots won't walk through you (and you can push them by walking into them)
[*]VR: Improved the "Reset VR Pose" option to also show in the "Input" menu, but only when Sitting/Mixed modes are enabled
[/list]

[*]Graphics: fixed UV mapping on the bottom of platform towers
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed telelocator ball physics collisions with player (also should fix VR quick-access inconsistencies)
[*]VR rain fix attempt (doesn't seem to work yet)
[/list]
v1.77, May 20th, 2016:
[list]
[*]VR: Made a change to hopefully fix rain in VR... testing.
[/list]
v1.78, May 23rd, 2016:
[list]
[*]VR: Fixes to construction tool use
[/list]
v1.79, May 25th, 2016:
[list]
[*]VR: Updated to OpenVR v1.0.0
[*]Grappling hook & other projectiles will now disable when entering the map
[/list]
v1.80, May 25th, 2016:
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash caused by a SetDamagedBy problem, could have happened randomly
[/list]
v1.81, May 29th, 2016:
[list]

[/list]

notes.notes:
[b]WARNING: Terrain generation has changed to address issues listed below! If you load your game in a bad spot, select "Location Rescue" from the pause menu. You may need to set a new Backup location.[/b]
[list]
[*]Spawn point rework: should reduce bots ending up underground, especially around roads. Objects shall also be placed in better areas.
[*]Buildings: flattened areas around buildings & increased chances of them being properly populated.
[*]Pilot & vehicle improvements: you can now control ship speed by holding forward or backwards. Pilot skill points will now affect the ship's health and damage (subject to future balancing).
[*]Reworked how headquarter leaders are spawned: should be more reliable.
[*]Reduced weight of health & energy consumables.
[*]Tweaked skill explanations to be more informative.
[*]Surveyors will now continue to spawn late in the game, alongside Collectors. Collectors will no longer give conversion points.

[*]Added a "no players created!" dialog when trying to join a multiplayer game with no saved players to join with.
[*]Fixed 2 rare crashes: one in TeslaCoil.canZap (seen on death) & during physics object creation for turrets.
[*]Fixed player not getting damaged from beams.
[*]Fixed vehicles flying off wildly when in virtual reality.
[*]Various small virtual reality improvements, like not blurring the menu when underwater or tweaks to the Vive weapon/hand pose.
[/list]

There is a known "screen goes black" problem when playing in virtual reality, and I think it is related to the shadow effect after playing for awhile. If you have this problem, restart the game & disable the shadow effect. I'm hoping to find & fix this as quickly as possible...

Thank you again for your support & feedback!

[b]EDIT:[/b] Small update on Windows today (2/26/2016) adjusts the launch script to better run on 32-bit machines.

notes.title: Update v1.21
notes.notes:
This is primarily an important bugfix release!
[list]
[*]Fixed floating bots & players in multiplayer
[*]Fixed a crash when picking dialog responses near the end of the game
[*]Renamed "Violet Towers" to "Violet Headquarters" to better distinguish them from the small watch towers
[*]Spawning fixes: spawn points won't be generated underneath or inside roads
[*]Spawning fixes: boxes & robots won't be spawned in areas that don't have physics generated yet
[*]Performance improvement in terrain generation (found when fixing spawn points)
[*]Some small tweaks to hopefully catch very rare situations where you get a "System Failure" message, but don't actually die
[/list]

The 2 spawning fixes should [b]hopefully[/b] significantly reduce bots appearing underground or stuck in walls. The biggest problem that I believe was causing it was when a robot was placed before the physics control was created for an area -- causing the robot to fall through floors until the physics caught up.

I also hope renaming "Violet Towers" to "Violet Headquarters" will help clear up confusion on what building to expect a leader at the top: the massive, multi-floor ones with violet spiked roofs.

Keep the feedback & suggestions coming! Thank you again for your support, it is greatly appreciated.

notes.title: Update v1.20
notes.notes:
Thank you again for your feedback! Here are the changes in v1.19:
[list]
[*]Spiderbots no longer cause explosion damage when they die.
[*]Homing projectiles shall now target "center of mass" instead of just its physics position.
[*]Convert & expand tools now have a reduced & fixed burden value of 0.5.

[*]Linux: Including Java 9, which people report better success with. 5089 will now try to launch with your default Java installation, if the included Java doesn't work.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Windows: Hopeful launcher bug fix introduced in v1.19
[*]Windows: Update included Java to 8_u74
[*]Leaders in violet towers will no longer "wander" (so they will be found easier at the top).
[*]More tweaks to violet tower spawning. Hopefully they will be more reliably placed on top of towers now!
[*]Updated to OpenVR 0.9.15 library
[/list]

An item comparison feature & investigating floating multiplayer bots are high on the priority list.

notes.title: Update v1.18
notes.notes:
[b]WARNING: Terrain generation has changed! You may load a game inside a wall or mountain. There is an easy fix -- select "Location Rescue" from the pause menu. It will reset you somewhere safely.[/b]

[b]WARNING #2: Accuracy numbers will be displayed differently to better reflect a weapon's behavior. A weapon that previously had 40% Accuracy will now show 0% (since 40% was the lowest number before this update). Accuracy has been increased for multi-shot weapons, too.[/b]

[h1]Primary Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The primary change in this update is cleaning up the starting area -- you should be more likely to start in a flat base with more important stations.
[*]Buildings should also no longer be buried by terrain in certain situations.
[*]Increased hitboxes for smaller targets (normal robots, antbots etc.)
[*]You can now hit legs of antbots & spider bots.
[*]Mac users should now be able to set resolution by changing the "resolution.txt" file in the base 5089 installation directory. First line is the resolution width, second is the height.
[*]Rare runtime crash fixed (reported on phr00t.com).
[*]Other smaller fixes, like blue overlay showing over GUI in water, typos & beam sounds.
[/list]
[i]New changes in v1.18:[/i]
[list]
[*]Accuracy number display changes, described above.
[*]Reduced accuracy penalty from multi-shot (shotgun) weapons.
[*]Fixed recoloring ammo boxes.
[/list]
I updated the GLFW & LWJGL 3 libraries. I'm hoping this will help Linux users & others with odd GLFW-related problems. I haven't confirmed these will resolve issues yet, but using the latest will make sure if it was fixed elsewhere already -- 5089 will have the fix.

[h1]Having problems with accuracy or difficulty?[/h1]

Don't forget there is a "Game Speed" option (under "Effects Menu"), where you can slow the game down. Might make it easier to learn the ropes at a slower pace.

Projectiles seem to be distributing as expected across the crosshair. I've increased the hitbox & legs should now properly register hits.

[b]Accuracy tips[/b]: your first item may not be very accurate, although pick up a Launcher if you want the best base accuracy "out of the gate". However, it will come at a cost of fire rate. Homing is another stat to look out for, which will help shots hit their mark. Hoverboard use will allow you to "hover" in a direction while not taking any movement penalty on accuracy. Finally, constructing an item with a scope will give you the best long-range accuracy when the scope is used! Always be on the lookout for better rarity weapon parts with better accuracy (among other important stats). Once you find a part you really like, build a complete weapon around it.

[b]An important part of this game is improving/customizing your items & picking the right tool for the job![/b] Guns, as with many other items, have different use cases & stats. Don't forget there always is melee attacks, which can be very fun to use!

[h1]I wasn't able to get everything I wanted to in this update![/h1]

I'm still going through feedback & there are some important things on the to-do list:
[list]
[*]Leaders not appearing (or being duplicated) at the top of violet towers. A possible workaround, if one doesn't spawn, is to open the map. Pan the map far away, so the tower disappears. Then, close the map. The tower you are in should get reloaded & the spawn point for the leader at the top may get reset. This is both a bug & a current possible workaround. ;-)
[*]Item comparison feature.
[/list]
Thank you again for your support & feedback! I'm going to keep working on another update & let me know how this one goes!

notes.title: Working on an update!
